composition.serve_who: This is GMMS 108'-115 "AFT SERVICE PUMPS" — DC Main Panel breaker/relay/terminal wiring for the aft grey-water and sump pump group. The load names printed on each breaker/circuit (AFT GREY WATER P., PORT AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, FWD CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP, AFT CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP, AFT A/C SUMP PUMP) match the engineer-confirmed mapping vocabulary directly to node 530-grey-water-pumps (AFT GREY WATER = grey water pump) and 530-sump-pumps (all the "...SUMP" named pumps: Port/Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sump, Fwd/Aft Crew Head Sump, Aft A/C Sump). The PC CARD run-indicator/alarm terminal block, T/S B/C/E terminal strips, and the DC Main Panel bus itself are shared panel infrastructure serving these loads, not equipment in their own right, so they are logged under the panel/infrastructure node 640-dc-distribution. Emergency battery +24V backup feed (T/S E-8) and Emergency Lts SW link are cross-references to 693-emergency-lighting and 632-battery-emergency respectively, walked but not detailed here since their own wiring lives elsewhere.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Grey Water Pumps (AFT Grey Water Pump)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Breaker Q1 10A is labelled 'AFT GREY WATER P.' — engineer-confirmed mapping AFT GREY WATER PUMP -> 530-grey-water-pumps. Feeds the AFT GREY WATER pump shown top-right of sheet plus its tank-level sender.

functions.label: AFT grey water pump supply and run/alarm indication
functions.sheet_region: top-left DC Main Panel / PC CARD column, top-right pump symbol
functions.what_it_does: Supplies 24V DC to the AFT grey water discharge pump and reports its run/alarm state back through the PC CARD terminal block to the monitoring loom (XA61 taps).

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel bus -> breaker Q1 (10A) -> switch -> Re12 relay coil path / terminal strip T/S C (terminals 76-81) -> PC CARD boundary -> AFT GREY WATER pump

Re12 contact -> T/S C terminal 77 (fused) -> RUN IND. tap on PC CARD boundary -> XA61 pin 10 (status); T/S C terminal 80/81 -> ALARM tap -> XA61 pin 12 / pin 08 (status) -> monitoring system (cross-ref 652-onyx-monitoring)

key_components: relay Re12 (run/alarm relay for this pump)
fused terminal 77 on T/S C (troubleshooting culprit)
AFT grey water level sender (variable resistor, wired via SWB02/AFT -XA70 07/08)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, breaker Q1 10A; relay Re12 coil energising path only partially traced on this sheet — negative/return side to Re12 not fully drawn (dead-ends at PC CARD boundary).

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Sump Pumps (Port/Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sump, Fwd/Aft Crew Head Sump, Aft A/C Sump)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Breakers Q2-Q6 are individually labelled PORT AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, STBD AFT GREY GUEST SUMP, FWD CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP, AFT CREW HEAD SUMP PUMP, AFT A/C SUMP PUMP — each maps by the engineer-confirmed vocabulary to 530-sump-pumps. All share the same PC CARD run-indicator/alarm terminal block and MAST BILGE/ENGINE ROOM BILGE/OWNERS GREY SUMP/FWD GUEST GREY SUMP/AFT A/C SUMP status taps (terminals 92-96) feeding the same monitoring loom.

functions.label: Port & Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sump pumps — supply and common run indication
functions.sheet_region: left DC panel breakers Q2/Q3, PC CARD terminals 82-85, right-side pump symbols with 1A fuses
functions.what_it_does: Feeds the Port and Stbd Aft Guest grey-water sump pumps and reports each pump's run status via lamp indicators; both indicator circuits share a common 1A fused rail.

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel bus -> breaker Q2 (20A) -> terminal strip pins 82/83 -> switch (unlabeled, positive side not traced) -> PORT AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pump; return not traced on this sheet
DC Main Panel bus -> breaker Q3 (20A) -> terminal strip pins 84/85 -> switch (unlabeled, positive side not traced) -> STBD AFT GUEST GREY SUMP pump; return not traced on this sheet

terminals 82/83 and 84/85 both feed a shared 1A fused rail -> RUN IND. lamps (82/83) and (84/85) -> back to PC CARD boundary; the 1A fuse is a known troubleshooting culprit for BOTH pump indicator circuits since it is common to them

key_components: shared 1A fuse on the RUN IND. common rail (troubleshooting culprit — affects both pumps' indicators if blown)
fused terminals 83, 85 on PC CARD terminal block
functions.dry_data: 24V DC; Q2/Q3 = 20A breakers; indicator fuse rated 1A. Positive feed side of each pump's local switch and the negative/return side of both pumps are NOT traced on this sheet (only an unlabeled 'left wire in' is drawn) — incomplete circuit.

functions.label: Fwd & Aft Crew Head Sump pumps — supply, relay control, and reed-switch bypass
functions.sheet_region: left DC panel breakers Q4/Q5 with relays Re13/Re14, PC CARD terminals 86-91, right-side pump symbols with BY-PASS/REED SUMP SW
functions.what_it_does: Feeds the Fwd and Aft Crew Head grey sump pumps through dedicated relays (Re13, Re14); each pump has a manual BY-PASS switch in series/parallel with a reed (float) sump switch that can independently complete the pump's negative return, allowing either automatic float-triggered running or manual bypass.

flow_scenarios.state: normal automatic run — Fwd Crew Head pump
flow_scenarios.path: breaker Q4 (10A) -> manual switch -> Re13 coil (negative supplied here) and terminal 86; Re13 contact feeds HEAD SUMP PUMP fuse (10A) -> FWD CREW HEAD GREY SUMP pump; pump return completed via reed float switch (REED SUMP SW., NC/NO conflict noted) or the BY-PASS switch in the same loop -> terminal 88 -> back to Re13/86 loop

flow_scenarios.state: manual bypass — Fwd Crew Head pump
flow_scenarios.path: same feed as above; operator closes BY-PASS switch instead of relying on the reed float switch, completing the same return path to run the pump regardless of float level

flow_scenarios.state: normal automatic run — Aft Crew Head pump
flow_scenarios.path: breaker Q5 (10A) -> manual switch -> Re14 coil (negative supplied here) and terminal 89; Re14 contact feeds HEAD SUMP PUMP fuse (10A) -> AFT CREW HEAD GREY SUMP pump; pump return completed via reed float switch or BY-PASS switch -> terminal 91 -> back to Re14/89 loop

flow_scenarios.state: manual bypass — Aft Crew Head pump
flow_scenarios.path: same feed as above; operator closes BY-PASS switch to bypass the reed float switch
terminal 87 (Fwd) and terminal 90 (Aft) tap RUN IND. status back to PC CARD boundary / monitoring loom

key_components: relay Re13 (Fwd Crew Head control relay)
relay Re14 (Aft Crew Head control relay)
reed (float) sump switch per pump — engineer-noted CONFLICT: symbol drawn as NC but wiring measured as NO; verify at inspection
manual BY-PASS switch per pump, wired in parallel/series with the reed switch
functions.dry_data: 24V DC; Q4/Q5 = 10A breakers; head sump pump fuses rated 10A each.

functions.label: Aft A/C Sump pump — supply and status monitoring
functions.sheet_region: left DC panel breaker Q6, PC CARD terminals 97-101 with S18 selector, right-side pump symbol
functions.what_it_does: Feeds the Aft A/C sump pump; provides a RUN/OFF/AUTO selector (S18) locally at the panel and reports run/alarm status to the monitoring loom via XA61 taps.

flow_scenarios.path: DC Main Panel bus -> breaker Q6 (20A) -> terminal block (97-101) -> S18 selector switch (ON/OFF/AUTO) -> AFT A/C SUMP pump via 1A fused rail shared with the guest-sump indicator circuit; negative/return side not traced on this sheet
terminal 97 -> RUN IND. tap (fused) -> XA61 pin 04/06/02 -> monitoring loom (cross-ref 652-onyx-monitoring); terminal 100/101 -> ALARM tap -> same loom

key_components: shared 1A fuse on indicator rail (troubleshooting culprit)

infrastructure.system_name: DC Main Panel / PC CARD terminal & monitoring backbone
facts: DC Main Panel bus feeds breakers Q1-Q6 for this pump group (Q1 10A, Q2 20A, Q3 20A, Q4 10A, Q5 10A, Q6 20A).
PC CARD dotted-boundary module carries numbered terminal block 76-105 relaying run-indicator/alarm status between the breaker/relay side and the pump side.
T/S B terminals 19/20 = not used (spare). T/S E terminals 19/20 also present near EMERGENCY LTS SW Link, terminal 57.

MAST BILGE, ENGINE ROOM BILGE, OWNERS GREY SUMP, FWD GUEST GREY SUMP, and AFT A/C SUMP status taps (terminals 92-96, common rail net216/net282) are fed/returned together as one shared monitoring rail — these are status inputs from OTHER pump circuits (not detailed on this sheet) riding the same PC CARD monitoring bus.
Emergency Battery +24V (T/S E-8, fused) is a backup supply tap into the PC CARD boundary — cross-reference to 632-battery-emergency.
Terminal 102 references 'see DWG115a' for FWD BLACK WATER TANK FULL SIGNAL — this signal only transits this sheet's terminal block, the actual black-water tank sensor circuit is on another sheet.
Terminals 103/104/105 tie to 'EMERGENCY LTS SW Link' -> T/S E terminal 57 -> cross-reference to 693-emergency-lighting.
Multi-core cable MU4-12 runs from this sheet's terminal block to T/S F (per 'see DWG-120'), carrying EMERGENCY LTS SW and two spare (not used) wires.

SWB02/AFT -XA70 pins 07(+)/08(-) feeding AFT GREY WATER SENDER level sender loop

uncertainties: Positive feed side of the local switches for Port/Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sump pumps and the Aft A/C Sump pump switch is drawn only as an unlabeled 'left wire in' — not traced back to a specific breaker terminal on this sheet.

Negative/return side of the Port/Stbd Aft Guest Grey Sump pumps and Aft A/C Sump pump (PUMP -> ground) is not traced on this sheet — only 'PUMP -> ground' stub shown, no negative bus symbol or traceable conductor.

Reed (float) sump switches on the Fwd/Aft Crew Head sump circuits: the printed symbol reads as NC but the measured wiring shows NO (CONFLICT flagged in contact-state data) — engineer should confirm actual state at inspection since this changes whether the pump defaults ON or OFF absent float action.
Re12 coil's negative/return side (the side that actually completes the coil circuit for the AFT Grey Water run/alarm relay) is not fully traced past the PC CARD dotted boundary on this sheet.
good_to_have: Exact 1A fuse values for the guest-sump/A.C.-sump indicator rail are visible on the drawing (read at inspection if needed).
Fused terminal numbers (77, 83, 85, 87, 90, T/S E-8) are known troubleshooting culprits — part/rating detail available on the drawing.
Relay part numbers for Re12/Re13/Re14 not printed — function is understood without them; capture at inspection if ever needed.
discarded_as_clutter: Title block repeat (DWG No., customer, drawn-by fields) — meta, not equipment data
Duplicate RUN IND./ALARM legend rows restating the same PC CARD status taps already captured in the terminal walk
Ambiguous 'XA'/'XAC'/'-XA' fragment labels in survey with no bound net — orphan OCR fragments, resolved via the netlist-bound XA61/XA70/XA30 tags instead
Grid-tile duplicate entries for terminals 82-85/86-91 already captured once in the assembled control loops
